timeline.heading: All transactions
timeline.malformed: The transactions could not be verified, so they are hidden.
timeline.refreshFailed: The transactions could not be refreshed. Showing the ones loaded earlier.
timeline.maybeStale: The transactions may be out of date. Check the ones above before trying again.
timeline.end: That is all of your transactions.

filters.invalid: Check the filters: the search is too long or the dates are not valid or are out of order.
filters.toggleHint: Kept open while the filters need attention.

feedback.unknown: We couldn’t confirm the change. Refresh expenses and check them before trying again.
feedback.refreshed: Expenses refreshed. Check them before retrying your change.
feedback.createdRefreshFailed: Expense saved. Expenses could not be refreshed. Refresh the list before making another change.
feedback.updatedRefreshFailed: Expense updated. Expenses could not be refreshed. Refresh the list before making another change.
feedback.deletedRefreshFailed: Expense deleted. Expenses could not be refreshed. Refresh the list before making another change.
feedback.missing: This expense is no longer available. Refresh expenses before making another change.

expenseForm.title: Add expense
expenseForm.amountInvalid: Enter a positive amount with at most two decimals, up to 9999999999999999.99.

cashIn.heading: Deposits
cashIn.intro: Money that came into your account, including transfers and refunds. Not counted as income, and not a paycheck unless you link it to a pay schedule.
cashIn.loadError: We couldn’t load deposits. Refresh deposits to try again.
cashIn.targetMissing: This deposit is no longer in the current list. Cancel this task to choose another deposit.

delete.heading: Delete deposit: {{description}} ({{date}})?
delete.body: This removes the deposit from cash-flow history. Any supporting paycheck link is removed; the saved pay schedule remains.
delete.imported: If this deposit was imported, importing the same confirmed statement again will not restore it.

feedback.created: Deposit saved. Reports use its deposit date.
feedback.updated: Deposit updated. Reports use its deposit date.
feedback.deleted: Deposit deleted. Recorded reports will reflect its removal.
feedback.createdRefreshFailed: Deposit saved. Reports use its deposit date. The deposits list could not be refreshed. Refresh deposits before another change.
feedback.updatedRefreshFailed: Deposit updated. Reports use its deposit date. The deposits list could not be refreshed. Refresh deposits before another change.
feedback.deletedRefreshFailed: Deposit deleted. Recorded reports will reflect its removal. The deposits list could not be refreshed. Refresh deposits before another change.
feedback.validation: Deposit was not saved. Check the details and try again.
feedback.unauthorized: Your session ended. Sign in again.
feedback.forbidden: You do not have permission to change this deposit.
feedback.missing: This deposit is unavailable. Refresh deposits before making another change.
feedback.unknown: We couldn’t confirm the change. Refresh deposits and check the list before trying again.
feedback.unknownChecked: Deposits refreshed. Check whether the change was saved before allowing another attempt.
feedback.refreshed: Deposits refreshed. Check the current deposits before making another change.
feedback.retryAvailable: You checked the deposits. Another attempt is now available; it will not run automatically.
feedback.blocked: Finish or close the open expense or import task before changing deposits.

fieldErrors.description: Enter a description of 1 to 500 characters.
fieldErrors.amount: Enter a positive amount with at most two decimals, up to 9999999999999999.99.

form.title: Add deposit
form.editWarning: Changes update recorded cash flow. If this deposit is linked to a pay schedule, that link stays and its recorded details update; the saved pay schedule stays unchanged.
form.amountReviewBody: Enter the exact amount again before saving.
